ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 40% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels localized on distal lateral lobes against 60% low-intensity (black) pixels dominant in the central and lower fluke regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark central region. Distinct high-contrast white mottling on the lateral outer lobes. The left lobe contains vertical dark streaks on a white field. The right lobe shows a more fragmented white field with denser dark speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated pixel-measured interior angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern across both lobes; right lobe shows higher frequency and amplitude of peaks/valleys on the medial-to-distal boundary compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature of the trailing edge originating from the median notch and sweeping towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity white clusters (consistent with barnacle scarring) are visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, particularly on the superior margin of the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible on the white-pigmented areas of both the left and right lobes, trending vertically from the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular indentations and secondary notches along the trailing edge boundary, distinct from the primary serration frequency.
